اختصرنا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَصَرْنَا (iḵtaṣarnā) /ix.ta.sˤar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اُخْتُصِرْنَا (uḵtuṣirnā) /ux.tu.sˤir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
